Birchland Manor: streets and boundaries

items.t: Birchland Manor is the small north-east Port Coquitlam pocket around Fraser Avenue and Prairie Avenue, east of Coast Meridian Road.
Birchland Elementary at 1331 Fraser Avenue is the named school on Fraser Avenue inside the pocket.
Prairie Avenue is the east–west street the TransLink 173/174 loop uses at Coast Meridian Road, on Birchland Manor's west edge.
Terry Fox Secondary at 1260 Riverwood Gate sits north of the pocket in Riverwood, the secondary school named for this side of the city.

items.t: 3630, not by the townhouse RTh or apartment RA zones used on the city's main roads.

blocks.text: Birchland Manor: rules that affect buyers

items.t: A Birchland Manor RS lot can hold a secondary suite inside the house: the Official Community Plan policy replaced by Amendment Bylaw No. 4373 permits secondary suites in single-detached houses, duplexes and triplexes.

blocks.text: Birchland Manor: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Solid waste fees are not on the utility bill: the City states solid waste fees are billed on the Annual Property Tax Notice, while water and sewer are billed separately by the end of February.
Multi-family homes in Port Coquitlam only pay solid waste fees if they have opted in to City waste collection services.
The 173/174 TransLink loop stops on Prairie Avenue at Coast Meridian Road, the closest named loop stop to Fraser Avenue in the timetable.
SD43's cross-catchment process for the 2027–2028 school year runs February 5–10, 2027, and approval is only for the one designated school requested, not a general transfer.
Blakeburn Elementary at 1040 Riverside Drive and Blakeburn Lagoons Park are in the adjoining Riverwood pocket north-east of Birchland Manor, not inside it.

blocks.text: Birchland Manor: costs and taxes

items.t: The 2026 annual water rate for each townhouse unit is $590.00, and for each apartment unit $456.00 for water and $458.00 for sewer, under the City's flat annual utility rates.
Utility bills are mailed by the end of February and due March 31, 2026, and water and sewer are provided on a cost recovery basis.
The municipal tax rate (Bylaw No. 4441) is set by the City of Port Coquitlam.

blocks.text: Birchland Manor: getting around

items.t: Birchland Manor has no train station: its TransLink service is the bus network on Prairie Avenue and Coast Meridian Road, connecting west to Port Coquitlam Station and Coquitlam Central Station on the 173/174 loop.
Coast Meridian Road is one of the city's two main north–south routes named in the Official Community Plan, with the Coast Meridian Overpass connecting the north side to Lougheed Highway.

blocks.text: Birchland Manor: risks and due diligence

items.t: Look the lot up on the City's flood resources at portcoquitlam.ca/flood: the City's own modelling shows protection against the 1:200-year flood but dike overtopping predicted in a 1:500-year event with 1 metre of sea level rise by 2100, and the flood page does not rate an individual Birchland Manor lot.

The City operates nine drainage pump stations that pump creek and drainage water over the dikes when river levels are high and flood boxes close — a north-side buyer should ask which drainage system serves the lot.
